_about: Visible upgrade paths (2026-11-14 owner request): every interactable area, the scout drone and the rover get levels V1..V4. V1 is today's model. Each level up costs spare parts (state.parts), is done at one of the track's stations by its specialist (empty = anyone), and changes both what the area looks like (scripts/upgrades/stages/<track>_stages.gd) and what it does (the effect tables below, read with AreaLevels.effect). Effect numbers are designer balance, never NASA figures, unless a source id is given in source_ids. The rover's look follows its existing module levels (state.rover.levels, 1..5), so its entry has no costs of its own: it is upgraded in the garage as before.

effect_notes.plant_o2_kg_per_hour: NASA-derived (S20 BVAD Rev2 Table 4-91: lettuce gives 7.78 g O2 per m2 per day, a sol average). Planted area is balance: V2 31 m2, V3 62 m2, V4 108 m2 of leafy plants, so 31 x 7.78 / 24 = 0.010, 62 x 7.78 / 24 = 0.020, 108 x 7.78 / 24 = 0.035 kg O2 per game hour. One crew member breathes 0.0373 kg/h (S20 Table 3-31), so the full garden covers about one crew member in four. Plants also take up 1.375 kg CO2 per kg O2 (physics, agrees with Table 4-91).

tracks.name: Power room and solar field
stages: Today's battery rows

effect_notes.battery_capacity_factor: balance (2026-11-14 energy worker): 700, 875, 1,050 and 1,400 kWh. Was 1.0/1.5/2.0/3.0; lowered so night still matters at V2 and V3 (a wasteful night uses about 340 kWh).
effect_notes.solar_factor: balance: bigger solar wings, multiplies every tracker's daytime output. At night solar is 0 kW at every level.
